title: General contractor run from a home office — Carolina, residential district (zone X)
description: I am a general contractor working from my home office in Carolina. Clients never visit; I do residential remodeling at their properties.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
General contractor: DACO contractor registration (Ley 146-1995). (KB: RULE_0123, RULE_0232, RULE_0237, RULE_0642)
Q_HOME_BASED: home-office declaration or domiciliary-use permit (expectation widened after first run: the engine models it as DOC_DOMICILIARY_USE_PERMIT).
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy. (KB: RULE_0020)

mustNotInclude.rationale: The contractor's own premises is a home office with no works; remodeling done at clients' properties is the service sold, not this business's project, so no construction permit belongs on its checklist (RULE_0644 fires on project_type=renovation read from 'remodeling').
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
A home office is not a change of use: RULE_0710 needs a confirmed change of use.
Home-based office with no client visits is normally a domiciliary-use declaration, not a commercial Permiso Unico (excluded_when_home_based).
